title: Leonardo Booster 與資料分區

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Leonardo Booster 與資料分區案例中比較Booster GPU與主機與InfiniBand層級，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate booster gpu and host and infiniband hierarchy within the Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions case.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Booster GPU與主機提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for booster gpu and host.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Booster GPU與主機。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify booster gpu and host in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交Booster GPU與主機的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for booster gpu and host.

knowledge.title: 節點與記憶體層級
knowledge.text: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 本課架構對應：Booster GPU與主機
knowledge.textEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Course architecture correspondence: Booster GPU and host

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.025，使用 16 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=11.6364。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.025 and 16 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=11.6364. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

quiz.question: 就Booster GPU與主機的「節點與記憶體層級」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nodes and memory hierarchy in booster gpu and host?
options: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。
統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access.
Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
quiz.explanationEn: CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.

steps.title: 節點與記憶體層級：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Nodes and memory hierarchy: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Booster GPU與主機提出可反駁的節點與記憶體層級模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nodes and memory hierarchy model and evidence record for booster gpu and host.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「節點與記憶體層級」模型，檢查Booster GPU與主機的兩個假想案例。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nodes and memory hierarchy model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving booster gpu and host. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。
steps.observationEn: Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：統一地址空間等於所有內存同樣快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unified address space means all memory is equally fast.
steps.check: 提交Booster GPU與主機的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for booster gpu and host.

steps.title: 節點內與節點間網路：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Intranode and internode networks: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對InfiniBand層級提出可反駁的節點內與節點間網路模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable intranode and internode networks model and evidence record for infiniband hierarchy.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識InfiniBand層級。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify infiniband hierarchy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observationEn: Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：節點內GPU互連規格等於跨機櫃網絡規格。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Intranode GPU rates equal interrack fabric rates.
steps.check: 提交InfiniBand層級的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for infiniband hierarchy.

steps.title: 工作分割與平行效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Work partition and parallel efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對partition工作流提出可反駁的工作分割與平行效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable work partition and parallel efficiency model and evidence record for partition workflows.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識partition工作流。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify partition workflows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
steps.check: 提交partition工作流的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

knowledge.textEn: Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Course architecture correspondence: Partition workflows

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.

quiz.question: 就partition工作流的「工作分割與平行效率」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for work partition and parallel efficiency in partition workflows?
options: 峯值算力翻倍保證每個應用時間減半。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
optionsEn: Doubling peak compute halves every application runtime.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.
quiz.explanation: 串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。
quiz.explanationEn: Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work.

steps.title: 儲存階層與檢查點：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Storage tiers and checkpoints: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對高效與容量存儲提出可反駁的儲存階層與檢查點模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable storage tiers and checkpoints model and evidence record for fast/capacity storage.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識高效與容量存儲。暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。 建立儲存階層與檢查點的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify fast/capacity storage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of storage tiers and checkpoints, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。
steps.observationEn: Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：容量大表示小檔隨機訪問一定快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Large capacity guarantees fast random small-file access.
steps.check: 提交高效與容量存儲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fast/capacity storage.

steps.title: 儲存階層與檢查點：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage tiers and checkpoints: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對高效與容量存儲提出可反駁的儲存階層與檢查點模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable storage tiers and checkpoints model and evidence record for fast/capacity storage.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「儲存階層與檢查點」模型，檢查高效與容量存儲的兩個假想案例。比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous storage tiers and checkpoints model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving fast/capacity storage. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：容量大表示小檔隨機訪問一定快。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Large capacity guarantees fast random small-file access.
steps.check: 提交高效與容量存儲的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fast/capacity storage.

Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of power, cooling and facilities, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

steps.title: 排程隔離與復原：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Scheduling, isolation and recovery: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對跨分區排程提出可反駁的排程隔離與復原模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable scheduling, isolation and recovery model and evidence record for cross-partition scheduling.
steps.instruction: 在「Leonardo Booster 與資料分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨分區排程。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify cross-partition scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on gpu booster and general-node workflow division. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
steps.check: 提交跨分區排程的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cross-partition scheduling.

Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。
steps.observationEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
steps.check: 提交跨分區排程的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cross-partition scheduling.

knowledge.title: 排程隔離與復原
knowledge.text: 多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 本課架構對應：跨分區排程
knowledge.textEn: Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Course architecture correspondence: Cross-partition scheduling

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.025，使用 16 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=11.6364。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
knowledge.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.025 and 16 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=11.6364. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.

summary: 以GPU Booster 與通用節點的工作流分工解析Leonardo Booster 與資料分區：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Leonardo Booster and data-centric partitions through gpu booster and general-node workflow division: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 公開伺服器與超算架構的離線工作流、通信、儲存及能量模型；非機櫃接線、供電施工或實體維護SOP，也不表示學員取得廠商／研究中心設備存取。
scopeEn: Offline workflow, fabric, storage and energy models of public servers/HPC. No rack-wiring, power-installation or physical-maintenance SOP and no vendor/research-center hardware access is implied.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設固定工作量有串行比例 0.025，使用 16 個理想同速工作者，Amdahl 上限 S=1/[f+(1−f)/N]=11.6364。通信、負載不均及I/O尚未計入，實效不得用此上限當實測。
workedExample.textEn: Assume serial fraction 0.025 and 16 ideal equal workers: Amdahl upper bound S=11.6364. Communication, imbalance and I/O are omitted; this bound is not measured performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.
